subject.title: WIP feat(cli): sync local schema artifacts on startup

question: Should OpenClaw accept default-on local editor-schema artifacts during config writes, and should this branch or the newer related implementation carry that product behavior?
rationale: The behavior adds persisted config/directory output by default, and the best current implementation path is a product and compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Adopt the newer root-preserving approach
options.body: Resolve the newer related PR's conflicts and use its proof-backed config-write-only contract if maintainers want default editor-schema artifacts.

options.title: Repair this branch first
options.body: Keep this branch as the source PR only if it preserves explicit `$schema` unset, avoids unsafe startup rewrites, and supplies real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep schema setup explicit
options.body: Reject default-on artifacts for now and leave users with `openclaw config schema` or a future explicit command/opt-in workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt the newer root-preserving approach
recommendation.body: Resolve the newer related PR's conflicts and use its proof-backed config-write-only contract if maintainers want default editor-schema artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config/schema and writer history makes this the best available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
